# Web ↔ native parity

<!-- Generated by scripts/native-parity.ts from the spec catalog, NativeRegistry,
     native/conformance/semantics.json, the golden and parity traces. Do not edit by hand. -->

Spec 0.10.0. The web (Svelte 5) renders every catalog component. The native
renderer (Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose) validates the same contract and paints a slice;
every other component paints a visible placeholder. Native is in development.

## Summary

| Measure | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Catalog components | 168 |
| Painted natively | 21 |
| Placeholder natively | 147 |
| Agent-emittable components | 75 |
| Agent-emittable and painted natively | 21 |
| Painted read-only (interactive on the web) | 0 |
| Components with a shared semantic rule | 37 |
| Golden traces (web = native) | 15 |
| Components covered by a golden trace | 34 |
| Parity fixture traces (web = native) | 1 |
| Components covered by any trace | 41 |

So the answer to "is web and native at 1:1 parity?" is: **for the contract, yes**
(validation, label interpolation and the golden semantic traces match); **for painting, not yet**
(21 of 168 components).

## Capabilities

| Capability | Web | Native | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Blueprint contract and validation | Validates and renders the spec through @texuli/spec and @texuli/player. | Validates the same spec version from the generated Kotlin; invalid fixtures are refused identically. | Parity | `native/texuli-spec/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/texuli/spec/runtime/SpecValidator.kt`<br>`native/conformance/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/texuli/conformance/InvalidFixtureParityTest.kt` |
| Semantic conformance (golden traces) | Writes one semantic trace per golden blueprint and per parity fixture. | Produces the same trace for every golden and every parity fixture; a semantic gate, not a pixel test. | Parity | `native/conformance/web/trace.ts`<br>`native/conformance/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/texuli/conformance/GoldenConformanceTest.kt`<br>`native/conformance/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/texuli/conformance/ParityFixtureConformanceTest.kt` |
| Label interpolation (i18n messages) | Interpolates component labels with @texuli/core/i18n. | Produces the same strings on the shared interpolation vectors. | Parity | `packages/core/tests/fixtures/i18n-vectors.json`<br>`native/conformance/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/texuli/conformance/MessagesParityTest.kt` |
| Painting catalog components | Every catalog component. | The ids in NativeRegistry; every other id paints a visible placeholder (see the table). | Partial | `native/texuli-compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/texuli/compose/Registry.kt`<br>`native/texuli-compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/texuli/compose/BlueprintView.kt` |
| Design systems and tokens | Validates, compiles and applies any design-system document (@texuli/tokens). | Decodes documents and validates the envelope reference; ships token sets compiled on the web side (Default and Acme); no Kotlin compiler for a brand document yet. | Partial | `native/texuli-spec/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/texuli/spec/tokens/DesignTokens.kt`<br>`native/conformance/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/texuli/conformance/DesignSystemFixtureTest.kt`<br>`native/conformance/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/texuli/conformance/DesignTokensConformanceTest.kt` |
| Decks | Deck model v2 with masters, transitions, notes and aspect (@texuli/deck, @texuli/slides). | Paints the deck layout and slides as titled sections; masters, transitions, notes and aspect paint a placeholder. | Partial | `native/texuli-compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/texuli/compose/BlueprintView.kt` |
| Workflows | Workflow editor, viewer and model (@texuli/workflows). | Validates workflow graphs identically; the graph does not paint natively. | Validation only | `native/texuli-spec/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/texuli/spec/runtime/WorkflowValidator.kt`<br>`native/conformance/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/texuli/conformance/WorkflowFixtureParityTest.kt` |
| Documents, forms, canvas and sheets | Editors and readers (@texuli/pages, @texuli/forms, @texuli/canvas, @texuli/sheets). | Validates their envelopes and caps; no painter, no form expressions, no sheet formulas. | Validation only | `native/texuli-spec/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/texuli/spec/runtime/SpecValidator.kt` |
| Data sources and dashboards | Host data sources and the dashboard (@texuli/data). | Validates sources; data components paint a placeholder. | Validation only | `native/texuli-spec/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/texuli/spec/runtime/Source.kt` |
| Agent tools (MCP) | The local and remote MCP servers (@texuli/mcp, texuli.com/mcp). | None: the tools run in Node and on the edge, not inside an app. | None | `packages/mcp/package.json` |
